name: Bothell Farmers Market
tagline: Mark Bothwell — Apples in Sultan, WA
description: Bothell Farmers Market gathers local farms and food producers in 23718 Bothell Everett Highway Bothell, WA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
